about: Name registry for the personal-educator pilot. One entry per design label: id (unique; clashing labels carry their place, e.g. R1@supply), spell (how it appears in text), means (plain meaning). ci: match case-insensitively. The learner model's names are keyed by these ids. The map builder adds entries when it maps a new region. A spelling can be {"s": ..., "ci": true} to make only that spelling case-insensitive.
